Tamara Mellon

Photo of Tamara Mellon
Tamara Mellon, a recipient of the OBE, is the cofounder and former CEO of Jimmy Choo, which she led for fifteen years. She detailed her experiences in the fashion industry with the memoir In My Shoes. Since selling her share of the company, she has focused on creating a new eponymous lifestyle brand. She divides her time between London and New York.
